incidents.title: Payment gateway returning 500 errors
incidents.description: Checkout requests to the payment gateway fail with HTTP 500 and customers cannot pay.

notes.author: Priya Nair
notes.text: Connection pool to the payment provider exhausted; threads blocked on a slow upstream call.

notes.author: Priya Nair
notes.text: Restarted gateway service and raised the connection pool limit from 50 to 200; added upstream timeout of 5s.

incidents.resolution: Restarted gateway service and raised the connection pool limit from 50 to 200; added upstream timeout of 5s.
incidents.closureNote: Verified by reporter; root cause documented.

incidents.title: VPN very slow for remote staff
incidents.description: Remote employees report VPN connections are slow and keep timing out since morning.

notes.author: Rahul Verma
notes.text: Replaced faulty VPN concentrator uplink and rebalanced tunnels across both gateways.

incidents.resolution: Replaced faulty VPN concentrator uplink and rebalanced tunnels across both gateways.

incidents.title: Laptop keyboard keys not working
incidents.description: Several keys on my laptop keyboard stopped responding after a coffee spill.

notes.author: Meera Iyer
notes.text: Replaced laptop keyboard assembly and tested all keys.

incidents.resolution: Replaced laptop keyboard assembly and tested all keys.

incidents.title: Reporting database queries timing out
incidents.description: Month-end reporting SQL queries time out against the core database.

notes.author: Priya Nair
notes.text: Added missing composite index on transactions table and refreshed stale statistics.

incidents.resolution: Added missing composite index on transactions table and refreshed stale statistics.

incidents.title: Payment application unavailable
incidents.description: The payment application is unavailable and customers are unable to complete transactions.

incidents.title: Payment transaction failing
incidents.description: Customer payment transactions are failing at the final confirmation step.

incidents.title: Unable to make payment
incidents.description: Several users are unable to pay invoices through the payment application.

incidents.title: Cannot login to SSO portal
incidents.description: Login to the SSO portal fails with an invalid credentials error for multiple users.

notes.author: Arjun Das
notes.text: Identity provider certificate appears expired; checking renewal job.

incidents.title: Shared drive running out of space
incidents.description: The finance shared drive is almost full and users cannot save new files.

incidents.title: Typo on leave application page
incidents.description: There is a spelling mistake in the heading of the leave application page.

incidents.title: Suspicious phishing email received
incidents.description: I received a suspicious email asking me to reset my password via an unknown link.

notes.author: Rahul Verma
notes.text: Please forward the original email as an attachment and tell us whether you clicked the link.
